description: Short description of Byteland: what buildings, rooms and lights stand for, units, privacy rules and supported languages. A good first call.
name: about
title: What Byteland is

description: Public detail of one building: the owner’s profile, rooms and their states, machine-readable parts and the building recipe.

lang.description: Language of text fields (recipe, badges, topic names). Default: en.

mode.description: kume (default): the founder’s real building with vacant buildings; bos: topic city, everyone vacant; ornek: demo street full of sample profiles.

name: get_building
title: Building detail

description: A developer’s or company’s profile: bio, links (GitHub, website, socials), badges, projects and open-source contributions. If not on the street, looks for a saved profile, then GitHub; otherwise generates a sample (preview:true).

github.description: Look up GitHub’s public data. Default: true.

lang.description: Language of text fields (recipe, badges, topic names). Default: en.

mode.description: kume (default): the founder’s real building with vacant buildings; bos: topic city, everyone vacant; ornek: demo street full of sample profiles.

name: get_profile
title: Profile

description: A single project of a profile. Returns nothing for private projects.

lang.description: Language of text fields (recipe, badges, topic names). Default: en.

mode.description: kume (default): the founder’s real building with vacant buildings; bos: topic city, everyone vacant; ornek: demo street full of sample profiles.

title: One project

description: Unique visits (all time and this week), project views, weekly rank and the last 14 days for one username.
name: get_stats
title: Visits of a building

description: Buildings in a range (owner, type, floors, light counts) and gaps (alleys, empty lots). Positions in centimetres, at most 80000 cm.

lang.description: Language of text fields (recipe, badges, topic names). Default: en.

mode.description: kume (default): the founder’s real building with vacant buildings; bos: topic city, everyone vacant; ornek: demo street full of sample profiles.

name: get_street
title: A stretch of the street

description: A profile’s projects: state, description, stack, links (repo, site) plus open-source contributions. Private projects appear only as hidden:true.

github.description: Look up GitHub’s public data. Default: true.

lang.description: Language of text fields (recipe, badges, topic names). Default: en.

mode.description: kume (default): the founder’s real building with vacant buildings; bos: topic city, everyone vacant; ornek: demo street full of sample profiles.

name: list_projects
title: Projects

description: The project rooms of a person that have been used (every public project of a resident has a room, open by default; one nobody wrote in is empty and not listed): mode (open or read-only), channels with message counts, forum threads, last activity and how many are in voice. Closed rooms and private projects never appear.
name: list_rooms
title: Rooms of a person

description: Voice rooms with people in them right now and the rooms with messages in the last 48 hours. Voice presence comes from the running site (BYTELAND_URL, default http://127.0.0.1:8787); without it only the recent rooms are known.
name: live
title: What is happening now

description: The leaderboard: buildings by unique visits this week (or period: "all"), the most viewed projects and the newest residents. A visit counts once per person per day; owners do not count themselves.
name: popular
title: Most visited

description: Builds a user's building as if it stood at the start of a street (GitHub repositories become rooms). The preview is not added to the city. Append the returned url_hash to index.html to open it on the site.

github.description: Look up GitHub’s public data. Default: true.

lang.description: Language of text fields (recipe, badges, topic names). Default: en.

name: preview_building
title: Deed preview

description: The latest messages of one channel of a project room (default: its first channel) and the forum threads (idea, review, question, announcement) with reply and reaction counts.

channel.description: Channel name or id. Default: the first channel.

project.description: Project id (the repository name for GitHub projects).

name: read_room
title: Read a room

description: One forum thread of a project room with all of its replies and reactions.
name: read_thread
title: Read a forum thread

description: Any public GitHub repository as a Byteland street: its top contributors (bots left out) with commit counts, who pushed in the last 30 days (their lights are on), who lives in Byteland, the total number of contributors, and the image and page links (street: an SVG for READMEs, page: the street page). total is null when GitHub will not list the contributors of a very large history; then the people are this month's committers.

repo.description: Repository name. Leave it out for the owner’s skyline: their public repositories (no forks) by stars, lit when pushed in the last 30 days.

name: repo_street
title: A repository as a street

description: Find people, projects and stacks across every resident of the city (people, projects, stacks), plus buildings on the street by username, name, project or technology (results). Private projects never appear.

lang.description: Language of text fields (recipe, badges, topic names). Default: en.

mode.description: kume (default): the founder’s real building with vacant buildings; bos: topic city, everyone vacant; ornek: demo street full of sample profiles.

radius.description: Street chunks to scan on both sides (1 chunk = 80 m). Default 4.

name: search
title: Search Byteland

description: Anyone's GitHub contribution calendar for one year, by month: contributions per day (with GitHub's quartile level), the total, days with contributions, the longest and the current streak and the busiest month. image is the Byteland picture of it (twelve month buildings, one window per day).

year.description: A past year; this year when left out.

name: year_in_lights
title: A developer’s year
